SELECT
    customer_id,

    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'credit_score')::integer AS credit_score,
    credit_info::jsonb ->> 'currency' AS currency,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'utilization_pct')::float AS utilization_pct,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'total_limit')::float AS total_limit,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'total_used')::float AS total_used,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'num_credit_accounts')::integer AS num_credit_accounts,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'oldest_account_age_months')::integer AS oldest_account_age_months,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'late_payments_12m')::integer AS late_payments_12m,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'inquiries_6m')::integer AS inquiries_6m,
    (credit_info::jsonb ->> 'bankruptcy_flag')::boolean AS bankruptcy_flag

FROM "qversity"."silver"."stg_customer"
WHERE credit_info IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    customer_id,

    (digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'mobile_app_registered')::boolean AS mobile_app_registered,

    (digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'web_banking_registered')::boolean AS web_banking_registered,

    digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'last_login_date' AS last_login_date,

    (digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'avg_monthly_logins')::integer AS avg_monthly_logins,

    digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'preferred_channel' AS preferred_channel,

    (digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'push_notifications')::boolean AS push_notifications,

    (digital_engagement::jsonb ->> 'paperless_statements')::boolean AS paperless_statements

FROM "qversity"."silver"."stg_customer"
WHERE digital_engagement IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone_number,
    date_of_birth,
    gender,
    nationality,
    city,
    country,
    adress,
    lat,
    lon,
    registration_date,
    kyc_status,
    risk_score,
    customer_segment,
    relationship_manager,
    status

FROM "qversity"."silver"."stg_customer"
